findings.finding: Historical caller graph has 38 unique SQL caller references with 76 lexical edges and 21 trigger bindings; this does not certify runtime execution.
Six external records are a separate identity/lifecycle domain and cannot simply be added to SQL caller count.
Verified historical SOAK receipt 38 covers 13 screens, 47 families, zero false PASS and zero D4 but is not an E2E or current CP2 authorization receipt.
Current readonly principal and permissions readback cannot establish historical P0 EXECUTE grants; EKB 42501 is not a functional CP2 failure.
Historical event source, verified SOAK receipt, and last EKB observation occur at distinct timestamps before P0; evidence should be versioned per claim.
No qualified E2E latency cohort or runtime execution trace was found within the inspected source fields. Zero rows with track_functions none does not show zero calls or speed.
Synthetic SQL valid, wrong and NULL denominator cases fail/accept as expected; these are guard tests, not proof of business rules or applied repair.
